name: 5pc Outdoor Table and Chairs, Aluminum Patio Dining Set for 4 w/ HDPE Materials Dinner Table
material: alu frame w/t powder coated.w/t polyester fabric and safety glass tabletop
description: Bring the comforts of the kitchen outside with a Sunburst outdoor dining set. This 5 piece patio furniture set includes a table and chairs for 4, so you can sit down to a nice meal, share drinks, or play a game. The table includes an umbrella hole, letting you customize and color coordinate your source of shade. Made of HDPE, this set has a wood-like look, a waterproof build and its slats help you to quickly drain away the rain. Get out, get comfy, get Sunburst.
